implementation.builtin: reshape(tensor,[dimensions]) preserves element identity and logical row-major order
implementation.lowering: Shared checked dimension/byte/stride/count guards and managed output copy; tensor source and output logical coordinates unflattened independently
implementation.continuations: Ordered input/dimension operands preserved through synthetic direct task kernels and imported helper/callback graphs

contract.rank: Output fixed by call-site list; empty list gives rank zero and requires one element
contract.counts: Input/output element counts equal; static contradictions diagnosed, dynamic counts checked before output allocation
contract.memory: Ordered managed copy; non-contiguous input respected, original remains unchanged, result retained independently
contract.errors: Existing Shape/Allocation/Arithmetic channels and cooperative cancellation; no partial output
contract.placement: Completed CPU tensors only; no implicit download, array reinterpretation or conversion
